register_eval_resolver: register an eval resolver in OmegaConf to evaluate string expressions in Hydra configs
register_str_resolver: register a str resolver in OmegaConf to convert values to strings in Hydra configs
register_tuple_resolver: register a tuple resolver in OmegaConf to convert lists to tuples in Hydra configs
register_prod_resolver: register a prod resolver in OmegaConf to compute the product of list elements in Hydra configs
register_isequal_resolver: register an isequal resolver in OmegaConf to compare two values for equality in Hydra configs
